text: DSKIN 是面向 DSH Web 的像素小猫皮肤，在页面底边生成可互动的猫咪，不改动原有界面布局。猫咪会散步、相遇玩耍、响应点击和拖拽；爪形面板可调整数量、切换品种和静音，并记住猫咪配置。适合想为 DSH Web 添加轻量装饰互动的用户。插件会定期向 GitHub 检查版本；无需模型密钥或额外服务配置。

DSKIN adds pixel kittens to the bottom of DSH Web without changing its layout. Cats stroll, play, and react to clicks or dragging. The paw panel changes their number and breeds, toggles sound, and saves preferences locally. It periodically checks GitHub for updates; no model API key is required.

DSKIN 的像素猫群：DSH Web 页面底边会出现一到四只猫咪，它们自行散步并在靠近时互动玩耍。数量可通过爪形面板调整。
DSKIN 的猫咪换装与面板：点击猫咪选中后，可在爪形面板切换品种，也可调整猫咪数量或随机更换全员外观；选择会保存在本地。
DSKIN 的拖拽互动：用户可用指针抓起并拖动猫咪，拖到屏幕顶边时可倒挂；点击、悬停和抚摸也会触发跳跃或爱心等反馈。
DSKIN 的猫咪声音控制：爪形面板提供猫叫静音切换，声音开关状态写入页面 localStorage；音效由浏览器 Web Audio 合成。
DSKIN 的版本检查：插件启动后延迟检查 GitHub 最新 release，并定期再次查询；面板可展示版本更新并提供打开发布页的入口。
DSKIN 使用 GitHub 检查版本，并将猫咪与声音偏好保存在 DSH 页面本地存储。

dskin README · Introduction：**1–4 pixel kittens** (🐱 大橘 orange tabby / 小白 white / 玄猫 black /

They approach,
chase, and play with each other. The **paw button 🐾** in the bottom-right
corner lets you toggle the palette to pick any kitten you like.

> **Pure presentation skin**: no service injection, no cordis events, no model
> traffic. Follows the official `dsh.client` client plugin contract —
> hot-pluggable and fully reversible on uninstall.

dskin README · 🔒 Privacy & Scope / 安全边界：DSKIN runs **only inside your own DSH Web app page** (default `http://127.0.0.1:3080`):

dskin README · 🔒 Privacy & Scope / 安全边界：- **Not a browser extension**: it never runs on other websites and never touches
  browser settings, homepage, search engine or other pages
- **No data collection**: no analytics, no tracking, no third-party scripts;
  it only reads/writes the DSH page's own localStorage (kitten config)
- **The only network request**: a read-only GitHub check for new versions every
  6 hours; the upgrade page only opens after you click the button
- **Fully reversible**: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dskin` + restart and
  the page is restored completely
